run_image_classification_training: run fine-tuning of a HuggingFace Transformers model on an image classification dataset using Accelerate
create_image_classification_dataset: create a dataset from HuggingFace hub or local image folder for image classification training
build_model_with_preprocessor: build a pretrained image classification model with image processor and config for fine-tuning
test_model_accuracy: test fine-tuned image classification model accuracy on validation dataset using evaluate metric
resume_training_from_checkpoint: resume image classification training from a previously saved checkpoint with automatic step detection
